text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've had an exhausting day, running in and
out of the academy to
prepare for
tomorrow's tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's going to be a big event,
especially for runners hoping to get
scouted. As I walk
home feeling nervous for tomorrow, I
stumble upon a curious sight.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hm-hm, hm-hm-hm! ♪
Hmm-hm-hm,
hm-hm-hm-hmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She isn't dressed up or even holding a
mic—not to mention the
complete lack of
an audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite it all,
she's pouring her heart into
singing and dancing, almost appearing to
sparkle as the evening sun casts its light
upon her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop in my tracks to watch her—not from
fatigue, but from the sheer charm she
exudes. Seeing her smile somehow fills me
with energy,
both physically and mentally.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though unable to stick around until the
end, I offer her a round of
applause as
thanks for her energizing performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day for tryouts finally arrives.
Excited to see what the new batch
of racers will
bring, I head to the academy in high
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Voice, check. Air mic, check. Flyers,
check. Perfect! I think I'm
ready! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyooone! Sorry to keep you waiting!
It's me, Smart Falcon! I
hope I make your
hearts race today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's time for Falco's special show,
so heeere
we gooo! First, I wanna
hear yo—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, waaaah?! You're the person from
yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The Falco Fan Club's very first member!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Woooow, what a coincidence! ☆ I actually
wanted to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But you left halfway through my show, so I
missed my chance. I was
kinda sad you
didn't watch 'til the end, but thanks for
the applause! ☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Wha—Smart Falcon! You're holding
another one of your flash
concerts, aren't
you?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oops, she caught me again. ☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
This is the fifteenth time this month!
You're going to drive me crazy
with all
these "cute and sparkly" acts of yours!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, looks like you've become a fan!
Thank you for your
support! ☆ But I can't
say I like that angry attitude! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With that said, I gotta run! ♪ C'mon!
You're coming with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what's going on. Swept up
in the moment, I end up
following Smart
Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Hey! Come back here!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew... I think we lost her. We should be safe now. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that was exhausting! ☆ Are you
okay? Thanks for sticking with
me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let me reintroduce myself! My name's
Smart Falcon, and I'm an
Umadol! You can
call me Falco though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: An Umadol—an Umamusume idol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols run like normal Umamusume...
but they also inspire their
audience during
winning concerts by shining onstage—like
an idol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to become a top Umadol one
day. That's why I'm doing
what I can to get
my name out there every day! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But well... I don't have a trainer at the
moment, so I don't think I'll be
racing
anytime soon,
let alone holding concerts...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait... Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... A-are you... like... uhhh... a
trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I guess my luck's finally turned
around!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought my first fan would
turn out to be a trainer?!
What a dramatic
turn of events—perfect for an Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here's your contract! All you need
to do is sign!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't have a pen? That's fine! I make
sure to carry one on me at
all times, along
with a full contract! After all, you never
know when you might get scouted! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, she's going to make me her
trainer by force... I should get
to know her
before this goes any further.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Urk.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Y-you mean like... in a race? Like one of
the ones today?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um... yeah... Technically speaking...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aw...
I thought I'd be able to convince you
with just my positive vibes...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Argh! Whatever! I can do this! Raaaagh! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I'll run! But you have to promise
that you'll keep your eyes
on me the
whole time, got it? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon seems to be trying a little
too hard to hype herself up.
Just as I'm
about to ask her why—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Get back here! Smaaart Faaalcooon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's getting faster! Sorry, but I
gotta go now! See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...In the end,
I decide to see just how well
this self-proclaimed
Umadol will run on the
track.
